sources.name: TOLL·402 editor's picks
sources.observed: MetaMask mcp-x402 is described as an MCP server that signs x402 payment headers from a provided key so MCP-capable agents can pay x402 resources without native wallet support. The same source lists x402-openai (Python) as a drop-in client that automatically signs and retries after HTTP 402.

candidateClients.name: MetaMask mcp-x402
candidateClients.observedCapability: MCP-accessible x402 signer/payment bridge using a provided key
blockingControls: signer secret must be inaccessible to the model/agent
per-payment and aggregate spend limits must be enforced outside the model
provider host allowlist must be enforced outside the model
payment recipient must be pre-enrolled outside the model and recipient drift must fail closed
settlement receipt and transaction identifier must be returned for audit
arbitrary transfer and funding capabilities must be unavailable to the agent
kill switch must be enforceable outside the model
candidateClients.note: A client that merely accepts a private key or can sign an arbitrary x402 request is insufficient under James's existing payment-capability gate.

candidateClients.name: x402-openai Python
candidateClients.observedCapability: client wrapper described as automatically signing and retrying an HTTP request after a 402 challenge
blockingControls: prove host and recipient policy enforcement
prove settlement receipt capture and replay protection

exactCapabilityRequired.signer: dedicated low-value signer with raw private key inaccessible to the model
requiredOperations: policy-check amount, network, asset, host and pre-enrolled payTo before signing
sign and submit the x402 payment header only after policy pass
retry the exact original benchmark request
return settled amount, transaction id, payer, recipient, network, latency, attempts, HTTP status and response body

nextGate: Do not spend. A candidate payment client becomes usable only after it can be represented by payment-capability.connected.json and passes validate-connected-payment-capability.js without weakening existing controls.
